behavioral_effects: None stated. An empty list is a claim that nothing observably changes.
compatibility_impact: read-surface.json breadth section gains shadow_roots and the internal schema requires it, so a pre-change artifact fails validation until governance-sync regenerates - the standard stale-manifest repair. The gate tolerates artifacts without the key (empty shadow set). events.jsonl is a new additive session-state file; sessions predating it are reported as without-telemetry by gate-metrics, never guessed at. No application code or HTTP contract changes.
follow_up: Phase 1: offline scenario harness (off/warn/deny arms) per the efficacy design; promote or demote roots only from gate-metrics evidence via evaluation records in governance/history/evaluations/.
limitations: Telemetry only accumulates in sessions started after the settings snapshot includes the recorder; the metrics denominator grows as old sessions age out.
reason: The breadth gate shipped enforcing but blind: deny verdicts leave no session-state trace, so deny rates per root, compliance after a denial, sweep decomposition, and marker-before-denial habits are all unmeasurable, and the [gate] roots list can only be tuned by guesswork. An ordered per-session event log, would-fire logging for candidate shadow roots that never deny, and an aggregation command turn tuning into evidence while keeping every loosening decision on the human side of the kernel ratchet.
rollback: Revert governance.toml breadth_shadow_roots, the gate script telemetry appends, builders.py, documents.py, hooks.py gate_metrics_report, the cli.py gate-metrics command, the Makefile target, and the test additions, then make governance-sync. Residual events.jsonl files in .cache are inert gitignored data; delete .cache/repo-governance/hooks/*/events.jsonl to purge. GOVERNANCE_GATE=off disables both enforcement and telemetry immediately without file changes.
security_impact: None additional. Telemetry records only repo-relative paths, verdict decisions, and the first 200 characters of governance query command lines, all inside the existing gitignored session-state cache; no file contents, no values. Shadow roots never deny, so no permission narrows or broadens at runtime; promoting a shadow root to enforcement remains a governed kernel change. gate-metrics is read-only over the cache.
summary: Gate telemetry: verdict event log, shadow roots, and a gate-metrics aggregation command
